title: STEVE-1: A Generative Model for Text-to-Behavior in Minecraft

layout.note: Three tinted dotted-frame panels left to right (green MineCLIP, yellow Prior, grey Policy) of different heights; the policy panel repeats three frame, ResNet and circled-plus columns over one wide VPT bar with actions below. Roughly the top third of the canvas is empty.

lesson: Give each model of a multi-model method its own tinted dotted-frame panel, and show the interfaces between them as short colour-coded embedding strips so the reader sees which modality each vector comes from.
